svg.title: Part 11 in one minute 2 · where the failure rate goes
svg.desc: PicoRV32 split by cell area, register file 43.2 %; one sky130 flip-flop has 24 transistors.
svg.text: split it by what the silicon is made of
PicoRV32 synthesised to 8,931 real cells; tile size = silicon area
Three kinds of silicon, three ways to split λ
by bits, plus a soft-error rate per bit
by gate count or cell area
by area, with its own failure modes
Big storage takes most of the λ, so cover it first.
PicoRV32 (ISC) synthesised with Yosys to sky130_fd_sc_hd (Apache-2.0); cell area only, no wiring or clock tree.
Flip-flop layout: sky130_fd_sc_hd__dfxtp_1, rendered from its GDS.

g.text: Terms: ALU arithmetic logic unit: the part of a processor that adds, compares and shifts · CPU central processing unit:
